**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------


This is not a traditional project\-management role focused only on schedules, meetings, and status reports.


At Mirabilis Design, the Program Manager works across the full business cycle, from **product development and bug resolution to customer evaluations, sales opportunities, support activities, and marketing programs**. For someone interested in developing into a future **Program Leader, Product Manager, Operations Leader, or Business Leader**, this role offers significant learning and responsibility.


You will have visibility into what is happening across the organization and will play a key role in keeping teams aligned, identifying issues early, and ensuring that important commitments move forward.


The role provides direct exposure to:


* Engineering and product development
* Customer requirements and technical evaluations
* Sales opportunities and commercial priorities
* Marketing campaigns, events, and programs
* Product releases and support activities
* Senior management decision\-making


You will not simply report progress. You will help **drive progress**.


For someone who wants to understand how a technology company operates end\-to\-end and build experience across product, operations, customers, and business, this is an excellent opportunity.


**Location:** Chennai, India, Hybrid or Remote as applicable  

**Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant experience, or recent MBA with strong internship experience

------------------


Mirabilis Design is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution\-focused **Program Manager** to help coordinate activities across product development, customer support, product evaluations, sales, and marketing.


This is a highly cross\-functional role with visibility across the organization. The Program Manager will work with engineering, sales, marketing, customer\-facing teams, and management to ensure that assignments are clearly understood, properly owned, progressing according to plan, and completed on time.


The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, following through on commitments, identifying risks early, and ensuring that teams remain aligned.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


The Program Manager will coordinate and track activities across multiple areas of the business, including:


* Product development and release activities
* Bug identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution
* Customer support and technical follow\-up
* Product evaluations, trials, and customer deliverables
* Sales opportunities and related internal actions
* Marketing programs, campaigns, webinars, events, and content activities


You will be responsible for ensuring that every important activity has clear ownership, timelines, dependencies, and measurable progress.


A key part of the role is not simply tracking whether an assignment has been made, but confirming that it is actually progressing as expected.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Coordinate activities across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and customer\-facing teams
* Maintain visibility into open assignments, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies
* Follow up with team members to confirm progress and completion
* Obtain regular feedback to verify that programs are progressing according to plan
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and execution risks early
* Escalate issues before they become major schedule or customer problems
* Track customer evaluations, support requirements, product issues, and related internal actions
* Ensure important customer and sales commitments receive timely follow\-up
* Help coordinate product releases, bug fixes, demonstrations, evaluations, and marketing initiatives
* Provide concise **daily progress updates** and structured **weekly management reports**
* Highlight accomplishments, risks, delayed activities, dependencies, and actions requiring management attention
* Continuously improve internal processes for planning, tracking, communication, and execution

**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------


Candidates should have one of the following backgrounds:


* **3\+ years of experience** in program management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, or a similar role


**OR**


* A **recent MBA graduate** with strong and relevant internship or prior work experience in technology, product management, operations, consulting, engineering, or program management

**Desired Skills**
------------------


The successful candidate should have:


* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to work across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to identify problems and bottlenecks before they impact delivery
* Confidence working with engineering, sales, marketing, customers, and senior management
* Ability to summarize complex activities into clear management updates
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving technology environment


Experience in semiconductors, electronics, EDA, software products, aerospace, automotive, or other engineering\-focused industries is an advantage.

Department : Project Incharge – Mission Education
Reports To : Regional Heads, Project Teams, Government Departments, Donor and Knowledge Partners **About Smile Foundation:**
Smile Foundation is an Indian development organization working for the welfare of underserved children and their families through intensive programmes focused on education, healthcare, skilling and women empowerment. We work as a catalyst in the cycle of change, complementing and supplementing government efforts, in alignment with the SDGs and ESG. We sensitize and partner with like\-minded institutions and individuals to implement high\-impact programmes that enable access, enhance quality and help bring long term behavioral change at the grassroots.
Started in 2002 by a group of young corporate professionals, today Smile Foundation has evolved into a national level development organization impacting the lives of over 2 million underserved children and families every year. With a project presence in 27 states across India, 10 offices in strategic locations, and a team of 1000\+ employees including more than 150 programme officers, 4000\+ onground facilitators from over 250 community\-based organizations, besides countless volunteers, wellwishers, and supporters.
Visit our website to know more about us and our latest development: www.smilefoundationindia.org **What’s our vision?**
Over the next few years, we are envisioning to scale our impact to reach more vulnerable children and families across India, by inspiring greater social action through a multi\-stakeholder approach, involving individuals, businesses, schools, government stakeholders and more. People, technology and data would be at the centre stage of every endeavor of Smile – we wish to establish as a unique organization in the social development space.
We are aiming at deeper and more diverse partnerships and collaborations with the business world in areas including CSR investment, ESG spending, shared value, impact investment, philanthropic partnerships and social stock investment. We will also be working to develop a loyal individual supporter base to strengthen the sustainability of the organization. **Project Overview**
Smile Foundation’s Mission Education initiative aims to strengthen STEM learning and innovation mindsets among students in government and government\-aided schools through experiential and hands\-on learning facilitated via Tinker Labs / STEM Labs for Grades 6–10\. This particular project focuses on ‘Activating Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) and will support students to develop 21st\-century competencies such as problem\-solving, creativity, critical thinking, and teamwork. Please visit our website www.smilefoundationindia.org/ for more information **Role Purpose**
The Project Coordinator will play a central role in coordinating and supporting the overall implementation of the ‘Activating Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs): Unlocking Innovation in Every School’ Initiative. The incumbent will ensure effective communication and coordination between the Head Office, regional project teams, schools, vendors and relevant stakeholders. The position involves program planning, monitoring, documentation, and reporting to ensure timely and quality execution across all project locations. **Key Responsibilities**
Program Coordination \& Implementation
 Coordinate with Regional Heads and field teams to ensure effective implementation of ATL and STEM components across all 36 schools.
 Support project planning, activity scheduling, and timeline adherence to ensure smooth delivery.
 Facilitate communication between HO, regional teams, and partner organizations for alignment on objectives, deliverables, and reporting.
 Track progress against project milestones and ensure timely completion of planned interventions.
 Coordinate logistics for ATL setup/activation, STEM activities, teacher trainings, student engagement, and community engagement activities.  

Monitoring \& Reporting
 Develop and maintain program dashboards, trackers, and progress reports in coordination with M\&E and Regional teams.
 Review periodic reports from regional offices and consolidate them for submission to the Senior Manager, STEM Manager and the donor.
 Assist in data collection, documentation of success stories, case studies, student innovations, and best practices.
 Support periodic field visits to monitor progress, identify challenges, and recommend corrective actions.  

Stakeholder Engagement
 Coordinate with government education departments, SCERTs, Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), and other institutional stakeholders for program alignment and permissions.
 Liaise with donors for progress updates, presentations, and communication materials.
 Facilitate workshops, review meetings, and cross\-learning sessions among regional teams and schools.  

Capacity Building \& Knowledge Management
 Support the organization of teacher training, orientation programs, STEM/innovation workshops, and exposure visits.
 Coordinate with content development and training teams to ensure contextual and quality learning materials.
 Maintain comprehensive documentation of training sessions, workshops, and field activities.  

Financial \& Administrative Support
 Work closely with the finance team to track project budgets, expenses, and utilization certificates.
 Support procurement and vendor coordination. **Qualifications \& Experience**
 Postgraduate/Graduate degree in Education, Social Work, Engineering, Management, or related field.
 4–8 years of relevant experience in education project management, preferably in STEM, ATL, innovation, or digital learning programs.
 Strong understanding of school education systems, government structures, and teacher development programs.
 Experience in donor coordination, report writing, and project documentation.
 Excellent communication (written and verbal), organizational, and coordination skills.
 Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint, and data management tools.
 Willingness to travel periodically to project locations. **Key Competencies**
 Strong program management and analytical skills.
 Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and geographies.
 Result\-oriented with attention to detail and quality.
 Collaborative mindset and ability to manage stakeholder relationships. **How to Apply:**

* Good influencing and interpersonal skills with ability to drive change.
* Good expertise and experience in EPC/EPS global projects execution in multinational and matrix organization.
* Financial mindset, contract and claim management skills

Travel according to business needs

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Assistant Project Lead
  
Project and Development Services – (Chennai/India)
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Pillar of the team
  
Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both),
  
you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of small projects,
  
and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore
  
ways to bring out the best in your team by striving to ensure optimal outcomes for all
  
stakeholders. Likewise, you’ll play a lead role in managing the organisational structure for
  
each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are
  
streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.
  
Your attendance at project meetings is necessary, and you’ll be expected to create project\-
  
related reports, analyses and reviews. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
  
is crucial; this role needs someone who is good at forecasting project expenditure and
  
ensuring effective management of project budgets.
  
Building strong client relationships
  
We live and breathe client satisfaction. We therefore need someone who shares the same
  
passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients
  
by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.
  
Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own
  
business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll
  
do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other
  
business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project
  
revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.
  
Upholding excellence in project delivery
  
For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help
  
continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for
  
the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration
  
of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect
  
commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and
  
implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong
  
focus on health \& safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front\-
  
of\-mind at all times.
  
Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems,
  
improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies.
  
You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.
  
Sound like you?
  
Our successful Project Managers ...
  
·
  
Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
  
perspective.
  
·
  
Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
  
·
  
Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
  
·
  
Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
  
·
  
Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
  
  

**To apply you need to be:**  

An expert in the field
  
We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
  
degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least three years of experience in
  
design, construction or project management.
  
Our project management teams are tech\-savvy and digitally enabled. We are the digital
  
leader in project management, so it’s important that you help drive the effective use of
  
JLL technology platforms to deliver our projects.
  
An empowering colleague
  
In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the
  
ideal candidate is expected to promote open and constructive relationships with
  
superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. With a healthy drive to succeed, you’ll achieve
  
your goals most effectively when you work together and collaborate.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
  
We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your
  
full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your
  
ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
  
package.
  
Apply today!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
